title: MNIST Vision Baseline
desc: The classic 28x28 handwritten digit recognition model using a 3-layer Dense stack with ReLU activations.
code:
layer Dense (128)
layer ReLU ()
layer Dense (?)
layer Dense (10)
layer Softmax ()

train on mnist
optimizer adam lr=0.001
epochs 5

title: CIFAR-10 Proxima Conv
desc: High-performance Convolutional Neural Network for 32x32 color image classification.
code:
layer Conv2D (32, 3)
layer MaxPool2D ()
layer Conv2D (64, 3)
layer Flatten ()
layer Dense (256)
layer Dense (10)

train on cifar10

title: Emotion Analysis LSTM
desc: Recurrent LSTM architecture for sequence-based sentiment analysis on text datasets.
code:
layer LSTM (256)
layer Dense (128)
layer Dense (?)
layer Dense (2)
layer Sigmoid ()

train on sentiment_csv

title: Tabular Price Regressor
desc: Regression model optimized for tabular housing data, featuring MSE loss and AdamW optimizer.
code:
layer Dense (64)
layer Dense (32)
layer Dense (1)

train on housing
loss mse

title: Fraud Sieve Autoencoder
desc: Unsupervised bottleneck architecture designed to detect anomalies in financial transaction streams.
code:
layer Dense (128)
layer Dense (32) # Bottleneck
layer Dense (128)
layer Dense (?)

train on transactions_csv
loss mse

title: Credit Score Classifier
desc: Industrial blueprint for bank-grade creditworthiness prediction. Identifies Good/Standard/Poor credit labels from behavioral and financial features.
code:
layer Dense (64)
layer ReLU ()
layer Dense (?)
layer Dense (3)
layer Softmax ()

train on credit_score.csv
optimizer adamw lr=0.001
epochs 10
batch_size 32
loss cross_entropy
